notes: Account background: mid-market ITSM vendor building internal helpdesk chatbot for support engineers and NOC. Product teams (PM + Eng) driving vendor selection.

Primary ask: replace heuristic macros + KB search with a streaming chat agent that can call tools (ticket open/assign, run diagnostics), provide sub-200ms first-byte for short responses, and keep full audit trail for compliance.
Quote from CTO on demo: "We need replies that feel instant for our admins — long tails kill adoption. Also need a complete audit log tied to ticket IDs."
Initial interest: Hosted API for quick POC then Dedicated for predictable latency & isolation if POC meets SLOs. Open to Private only if data residency required later.
Integrations: ServiceNow + internal agent tooling (Ops CLI), Okta SSO. Want function/tool-calling to open/annotate tickets and run triage scripts via a secure runtime.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — care about per-token economics; willing to commit to reserved capacity if latency and reliability are guaranteed at scale.
Security says: need audit logs retained 90 days, log export to S3 with KMS encryption, SOC2 evidence. Asked about retention controls and data deletion APIs.

requirements_summary: Workload: internal IT/helpdesk chat agent for engineers + on-call team; heavy mix of short lookup queries and multi-step troubleshooting dialogues.
Latency SLOs: target <200ms FBT for single-turn lookups; 95th <300ms for streaming small responses. Goal: perceived instant replies for admin UX.
Throughput: expect 100-150 concurrent agents at launch, spikes to 400 during incidents; need predictable autoscaling or reserved capacity.
Model preferences: prefer open/verified models with strong instruction-following; want ability to pin model version and fallback options (cheaper model for non-critical tasks).
Tooling: function/tool-calling (create/annotate tickets, run ops scripts) + streaming partial responses for UX while backend runs diagnostics.
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, trace linking from chat to ticket IDs, exportable audit logs.
Security: Okta SSO, SAML for console access, KMS for exported logs, retention controls (90 days default), SOC2 evidence requested.
Compliance: may require EU data residency for a subset of customers later — prefer option to route resident requests to region-specific model hosts.
POC success criteria: median FBT <=200ms, function-calls reliably execute in <2s end-to-end, audit log entries created for every action, no critical hallucination incidents on 200-sample QA set.
poc_notes: POC design: Hosted API baseline to validate latency + function-calling. Two-week dataset, synthetic concurrency test, integrated ServiceNow sandbox.
Metrics to collect: FBT median/p95, end-to-end function-call latency, token cost per session, failure modes for tool calls.
SE action items: provide Dedicated latency profile and recommended quantization / kernel configs, deliver a test harness for prefix caching and KV reuse.
Observed results: median FBT ~180ms on hosted dev; tail reduced after batching and cache tweaks; still evaluating noisy scheduled runbook flows.
Customer asks: sample SLA language, estimated committed capacity pricing with 12-month and 36-month options, upgrade path to Private if residency required.
